# fjordrun_models (Data Source)

The LLM models agents can use. Needs no token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_models" "all" {}

output "ids" {
  value = data.fjordrun_models.all.models[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `models` (Attributes List) The models. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

### Nested Schema for `models`

- `name` (String) Name.
- `output_eur_per_mtok` (Number) Output price per million tokens.
